launchLines.text: Suitcase Archive is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project made out of love for Reverse: 1999.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Bluepoch.
Reverse: 1999, its characters, names, story, and art belong to Bluepoch and their respective owners.
No game assets were ripped, extracted, or copied; images are placeholders pending permission or official press material.
Story summaries and descriptions are written independently in our own words.
No ads, paywalls, monetization, or items for sale.
Tier lists and team opinions are personal and may differ from the community.
Information is based on game version 3.8 and may contain errors or become outdated.
Rights holders may contact us at rights@example.com; we will respond promptly.
This good-faith statement is not legal advice and does not represent an official license.
